description: Scroll up/down/left/right by a number of pages (default 1). Without element_index: the center of the frontmost app's front window (the pointer moves there), only when that app's window is on top at that point (else occluded, nothing scrolled). With element_index: a scroll area is scrolled at its own center (hit-tested; reports when the position did not change), any other element is scrolled into view (AXScrollToVisible).
name: mac_scroll
